P0_FIN_01_promotionalAccountingConservat.resolution: Enforces complete financial conservation for platform-funded discounts: upon order finalization with promotionDiscount > 0, automatically posts balanced platform subsidy journal (PLATFORM-PROMOTION-EXPENSE-ZAR [Debit] / PLATFORM-CUSTOMER-FUNDS-HELD-ZAR [Credit]). Net customer obligation N_i + platform subsidy S_i = gross seller pool G_i. On order cancellation or refund, customer refund is strictly capped at net cash paid N_i, while platform subsidy S_i is reversed back to promotional expense, perfectly balancing seller basis and commission reversals without external refund exceeding remaining payment.

P0_A_grossVsNetPaymentPlanRevalidation.resolution: Rebuilds payment plan using net customer liability (gross - verified discount) and digitalMarketplacePaymentPlan policy matching review stage. Strictly enforces sum(gross) = grossCheckoutTotal, sum(discount) = promotionDiscount, and sum(net) = grandTotal, while disallowing COD for discounted orders.

P0_B_welcomeOfferLookupTransactionBounda.resolution: Introduced typed explicit WelcomeEligibilityAdapter. Production implementation binds checkFirstStoreWelcomeEligibility to the active serializable transaction client; unit tests inject deterministic eligibility fixtures while preserving fail-closed behavior on lookup failure.
